About Hinoki Workshop

Hinoki Workshop was founded in 2005 in Yoshino, Nara Prefecture — home to Japan's
finest hinoki cypress forests for over 500 years. Our founder, Yamamoto Kenji,
is a third-generation woodworker who trained under master joiner Nakamura Toshio.

Philosophy: Mottainai (もったいない)
We believe nothing should go to waste. Every off-cut becomes a smaller product —
chopstick rests from planing shavings, coasters from branch rounds. Our zero-waste
commitment means 98% of harvested wood becomes a finished product.

Materials:
- Yoshino hinoki cypress: naturally antibacterial, aromatic, sustainably harvested
- Kiso hinoki from Nagano: premium grade for our luxury cutting boards
- Natural beeswax and tung oil finish — no synthetic coatings

Signature Products:
- Hinoki cutting boards (hand-planed, not sanded)
- Cypress bath stools and buckets for traditional Japanese bathing
- Bento boxes with dovetail joinery — no glue, no nails
- Aromatic hinoki sachets for closets and drawers

Brand Voice:
Warm, knowledgeable, and grounded. We talk about wood the way a sommelier talks
about wine — with passion and specificity, but never pretension. We use "we" and
invite customers into our workshop through storytelling.
